an5.137:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave appaṃ rattiyā supanti bahuṃ jagganti.
an5.137:1.3: Itthi bhikkhave purisādhippāyā appaṃ rattiyā supati bahuṃ jaggati,
an5.137:1.4: puriso bhikkhave itthādhippāyo appaṃ rattiyā supati bahuṃ jaggati,
an5.137:1.5: coro bhikkhave ādānādhippāyo appaṃ rattiyā supati bahuṃ jaggati,
an5.137:1.6: rājayutto bhikkhave rājakaraṇīyesu yutto appaṃ rattiyā supati bahuṃ jaggati,
an5.137:1.7: bhikkhu bhikkhave visaṃyogādhippāyo appaṃ rattiyā supati bahuṃ jaggati.
an5.137:1.8: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca appaṃ rattiyā supanti bahuṃ jaggantī
